title: SAE Feature Faithfulness Under Distribution Shift

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Probes a necessary precondition for SAE-based safety audits: feature stability across distributions. If features shift on adversarial inputs, current interpretability-based safety tools are unreliable. High foundational value.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: SAELens provides infrastructure for training SAEs on GPT-2 Small. However, SAE training and feature analysis require understanding of sparse autoencoders, which is conceptually demanding for beginners. GPT-2 Small is compute-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Train one SAE, evaluate on two distributions, compare features. Clear deliverable (feature overlap metrics). SAE training can fit in 30 hours on GPT-2 Small but the analysis (cosine similarity, feature activation patterns) adds scope.
